_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest), judged by eye from the figures. 1: a word in capitals or a few plain shapes; 2: letters and digits, or shapes with a symbol; 3: shaded parts, letters inside shapes, or a row of symbols; 4: a long string of small mixed characters, or a detailed picture. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
